## Overview

We extend our toolkit for comparing groups, covering t-tests, chi-square tests, and ANOVA. We also look at how these classical tests connect to the linear regression framework, unifying much of what we have learned so far.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Download

Download the project for this week, unzip it, and double-click `09-content.Rproj` to open it in RStudio: [09-content.zip](/files/content/09-content.zip)
